node.statement: A and M have the claimed orientations. Every UCP map is positive and unital; D, Delta, Upsilon, and J therefore are positive unital, and the unital *-isomorphism iota and its inverse are positive unital. Compositions preserve positivity and the unit, so A=D Delta iota and M=iota^{-1} Upsilon J are positive unital.
